comparison.objective: Read an arbitrary routing card and sort three colored parcels into assigned chutes.
comparison.physical_skill: Visual rule interpretation, parcel grasping, and mapped chute placement.
comparison.success_condition: Red goes to C, blue to A, and green to B; any missort makes the overall score zero.
comparison.reason: Symbolic mapping and parcel sorting do not test force-controlled tool use, fracture, retained-insert integrity, or fragment containment.
